nodes.label: Safe-Change Rule
nodes.rationale: A friend already completed part of the frontend; avoid broad rewrites, route renames, or schema churn, and layer new work behind small, reviewable changes that preserve working behavior.

nodes.label: Honest-Fallback / No-Fabrication Theme
nodes.rationale: A sustained series of 2026-07-01 changes progressively replaces fabricated or derived dashboard fallback values (threat trends, session totals, queue usage, block timelines) with real backend-persisted or backend-polled data so charts stay honest during degraded periods.

nodes.label: Security UI And Copy Rules
nodes.rationale: Use accurate IDS terms (detected/blocked/watchlisted/blocked for future traffic) and never claim perfect inline prevention, since SmartIDS is a passive IDS with reactive mitigation, not an inline blocker.

nodes.label: Backend Base URL Port Inconsistency (3000 vs 3100)
nodes.rationale: Some frontend modules default to port 3000 (matching README) while others still default to port 3100, so developers following the README can silently call the wrong backend port.

nodes.label: DB Fallbacks Mask Broken Backend Integration
nodes.rationale: Direct DB/mock fallbacks on major live pages are useful during migration but currently hide backend auth/contract failures (e.g. silent 401s), so a page can look populated even when protected backend REST calls are failing.
